wrote: CRISIS — War of Chioggia, 1378-1381+ (age 60-63)

War of Chioggia (Genoa blockades the lagoon) started 1378, still ongoing as of 1381 summer — the longest, most expensive crisis yet, worse than the plague financially. Prices stayed persistently elevated (bread 2, good_meal 7, warehouse 510) for THREE+ YEARS straight, unlike other crises that resolved in 1-2 seasons. LESSON: "poor" eating tier is a bad trade — it tanked health (80->76) and hunger (100->48) for barely any money saved; not worth it, stick to "plain" minimum even when broke.
